preconditions.description: The number of points n is an integer between 3 and 2000 inclusive.
Each of the n lines after the first contains exactly two integers representing coordinates (x_i, y_i) of point A_i.

preconditions.expression: all(-1e9 <= int(x) <= 1e9 and -1e9 <= int(y) <= 1e9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Coordinates (x_i, y_i) of each point A_i satisfy -10^9 ≤ x_i, y_i ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()[n+1].strip()) == n - 2 and all(c in 'LR' for c in stdin.splitlines()[n+1].strip())
preconditions.description: The last line is a string s of length n-2 consisting only of characters 'L' or 'R'.

preconditions.expression: len(set((int(x), int(y)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1] for x, y in [line.split()])) == n
preconditions.description: All points A_i are distinct (no duplicates).

preconditions.expression: all(not collinear(A_i, A_j, A_k) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for k in range(n) if i != j and j != k and i != k)
preconditions.description: No three points A_i, A_j, A_k are collinear (no three lie on the same line).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(p) <= n for p in stdout.strip().split()) and len(set(stdout.strip().split())) == n)
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, stdout is '-1'. Otherwise, stdout is a permutation of integers from 1 to n, each between 1 and n inclusive, with no duplicates.

If stdout is not '-1', the permutation p_1, p_2, ..., p_n must form a non-self-intersecting polygonal line that is winding according to the string s. The permutation is derived by mapping the output integers to the original point indices.
